caption:
Men will blame their age for years before they blame the takeaway at 11pm.

The habits that change how a man looks are the same ones that change how he feels: sleep, food, training and a bit of care for your skin. The face shows it first.

Number 2 is the big one. The Aviva 2025 sleep survey found the average UK adult sleeps 6.7 hours a night.

Lads, which one are you worst at?

Save this for the Christmas photos, and send it to your brother, your mate or your dad.
